review.assessment: The change introduces a new `solution.mjs` containing an initial chunk implementation that builds subarrays and pushes them to a result collector only when they hit the target size. Because it never appends leftover elements after the loop finishes, any trailing items smaller than `size` are silently dropped instead of forming their own group. This leaves the exact bugs described in the task unfixed.

findings.at: Discards final partial group when array length is not a multiple of `size`
findings.defect: Partial groups are dropped instead of being added to the result.
